Message:

Redact lock ownership tokens from diagnostic output and normalize public core result models around Serializable contracts. Clean touched tests so the stack starts from repo-standard assertion patterns.

Constraint: issues #570, #576, and #577 are the base of the 0.5.0 stacked PR train.

Confidence: high

Directive: keep token material out of toString/log surfaces and keep Spring test classpath dependencies that framework test APIs expose.

Author: debop
Message:
feat: add leader-etcd client boundary primitives

Constraint: #227 needs caller-owned jetcd options, strict backend error classification, and stable ownership tokens before Lock client wiring.

Rejected: Treating expected cleanup as ordinary WARN-level backend failure | timeout cleanup must be identifiable so already-revoked lease/key errors can stay debug-only.

Rejected: Using ByteSequence.toString(Charset) for handle tokens | ownership keys are opaque bytes and non-UTF payloads must not alias.

Confidence: high

Scope-risk: moderate

Directive: Keep credentials and TLS out of EtcdLeaderElectionOptions; callers configure them on the jetcd Client.

Tested: ./gradlew :bluetape4k-leader-etcd:compileKotlin :bluetape4k-leader-etcd:compileTestKotlin :bluetape4k-leader-etcd:test --tests 'io.bluetape4k.leader.etcd.*' --tests 'io.bluetape4k.leader.etcd.internal.*' --no-daemon --console=plain; git diff --check; IntelliJ diagnostics MCP reported no build/test errors but file analysis was not fresh because the files were not open.
